title: CommandSpyLite
description: Lets staff see player commands in chat.
body:
# CommandSpyLite

Lets staff see player commands.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Permissions
- `commandspylite.see`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
format: "&7[Spy] &f{player}: &e{command}"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
